# ClickUp MCP Pro

> The most complete ClickUp MCP server — 161 typed tools + a clickup_raw escape hatch covering the entire ClickUp v2/v3 API.

ClickUp MCP Pro is an MCP server that lets you control ClickUp via the Model
Context Protocol from Claude Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop. It exposes nearly
every ClickUp operation as a typed tool (tasks, lists, folders, spaces, docs,
chat, goals, sprints, time tracking, custom fields, webhooks, guests) and falls
back to `clickup_raw` for anything not yet wrapped — giving 100% API coverage.

## Tools (161 typed + clickup_raw)

- Tasks: create/get/update/delete, bulk create/update/delete/move, duplicate,
  subtasks, links, dependencies, multi-list, custom field values, members.
- Workspace/Spaces/Folders/Lists: full CRUD + templates + views.
- Comments: task/list/chat-view comments, threaded replies.
- Checklists, Tags, Attachments (local path / HTTPS url / base64).
- Custom fields: list (list/folder/space/team) + set/remove values.
- Time tracking: entries CRUD, start/stop, manual, tags, history, time-in-status.
- Docs (v3): search, create, pages (get/create/update with replace/append/prepend).
- Views, Goals & key results, Chat (v3), Sprints, Webhooks, User groups, Guests.
- Members/resolvers: find_member, find_space_by_name, find_list_by_name.
- clickup_raw: call any ClickUp v2/v3 endpoint directly.

## Quick install

Add to your claude_desktop_config.json or .mcp.json:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "clickup": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "clickup-mcp-pro"],
      "env": {
        "CLICKUP_API_TOKEN": "pk_your_token",
        "CLICKUP_TEAM_ID": "9007012345"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Environment variables

- `CLICKUP_API_TOKEN` (required): Personal API token from ClickUp → Settings → Apps → API Token.
- `CLICKUP_TEAM_ID` (optional): default Team/Workspace id.
- `CLICKUP_READONLY` (optional): "true" blocks all writes.
- `CLICKUP_DISABLE_RAW` (optional): "true" hides the clickup_raw tool.
- `CLICKUP_UPLOAD_DIR` (optional): confine attachment file_path uploads to a directory.
- `CLICKUP_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` (optional): attachment size cap (default 50 MB).

## Known limitations

- Guest tools require a ClickUp Enterprise plan.
- Sprints are modeled as Lists inside a Sprint Folder (ClickUp has no Sprint API).
- Bulk operations cap at 100 items per call and fan out client-side.
